items.description:
Airdate (10/24/24) Unsatisfied with the troubadour lifestyle,
Max dreams of becoming a knight; after a run-in with
a thief Max and Uncle Budrick travel to Byjovia,
Budrick's hometown, but when they arrive, it's not as
Uncle Budrick remembers it.

items.description:
Airdate (10/24/24) When Uncle Budrick is held captive as
King Gastley's jester, it's up to Max to rescue him
from the castle's dungeon, with a little help from her
newest pals, Simon, Millie, Kevyn, and world-
renowned wizard, Mumblin.
